head: 10 new weather apps for iPhone climbing the App Store this week
dek: Ten weather apps that came out in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Weather charts this week, from Snow Day Radar's snow day odds to SkyWX's radar and alerts.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Weather charts this week
means: If winter weather decides your mornings, several of these are about snow: school snow days, ski forecasts and storm radar.
todo: Open an app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and the countries it covers before you download.

list.name: Snow Day Radar
list.what: Gives your US school district's chance of a snow day, a delay or a virtual day for the next school day.

list.name: Lite Sky
list.what: Sums up the forecast only for the hours of the day you choose, 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. unless you change it.

list.name: World Tides 2027
list.what: Gives a year of tide predictions for more than 9,700 places, with sunrise, sunset and moon times.

list.name: Snow Day
list.what: Predicts whether tomorrow will be a snow day and explains the reasons behind the odds.

list.name: FullSky - 3D Weather Radar
list.what: Shows US weather radar in 3D, so you can slice through a storm to look for hail or rotation.

list.name: Snow - Forecasts & Cams
list.what: Gives every ski area a snowfall forecast up to 15 days ahead, blended from several weather models.

list.name: Thermal Lab Pro
list.what: Shows hunters on a map where their scent drifts, from forecast wind and air moving up or down slopes.

list.name: ReadyAtlas: Emergency Map
list.what: Puts weather warnings, radar, wildfires, earthquakes and air quality on one live map.

list.name: Aguacero: Weather Radar+Models
list.what: Shows live radar, satellite pictures and forecast models such as GFS and the European model on one map.

list.name: SkyWX by Anthony Slaughter
list.what: US radar, local forecasts and severe weather alerts from a former TV meteorologist in St. Louis.
